scenarios.name: Toggle the lock marker on a copied view representation

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and leaves Primary active
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
Primary is the active view representation
an unlocked copied view representation exists in the expanded View branch
the user opens the copied view representation's context menu
a lock symbol appears beside the copied view representation
the user reopens the copied view representation's context menu
the lock symbol disappears from the copied view representation
the user reopens its context menu
